own_solution.law: Archimedes' principle and static equilibrium give T = Fb - mg = (rho_l - rho_s)g a^3. Using a = 0.15 m gives T = (1100 - 450)(9.8)(0.15)^3 = 21.49875 N.
assumptions: The liquid is hydrostatic, incompressible and uniform in density.
The cube is stationary and completely submerged.
The light vertical string pulls downward on the cube.
Lengths are converted to metres when using SI densities and gravitational acceleration.

T0525.regime: T < q; the required tension is below all listed breaking strengths of 30, 50 and 80 N.

T2CF7.regime: T < q; the required tension is below all listed capacities of 30, 50 and 80 N.
